title: Transport Client Services Manager
description:
Transport Client Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Transport Client Services Manager role exists both tactical (pre‑Tournament) and operationally (Tournament time) – shifting from planning & relationship management to execution & issue resolution.

The Transport Client Service Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and delivery of transport services for designated client groups during FWWC2027. Acting as the primary liaison between the Transport Functional Area and key stakeholders (such as FIFA Constituent Groups including; Teams, Referees, FIFA Senior Officials, Delegates and Guests, Workforce, Media & Broadcast and Commercial Affiliates), the role ensures that client transport requirements are accurately captured, planned, and operationally delivered in alignment with the FIFA Transport Operating Concept.

During the pre‑Tournament phase, the Manager oversees client engagement, gathers and validates detailed mobility requirements, and translates these into Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role is responsible for delivering the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs) according to agreed timelines and for gaining the necessary agreements and approvals, ensuring that the role works cross‑functionally with fleet planning, Venue and Arrivals and Departures Teams to ensure feasibility, readiness, and service alignment. The position also contributes to test events, readiness exercises, and data accuracy.

During Tournament time, the Transport Client Service Manager becomes the operational lead for assigned client groups, monitoring service performance, managing daily communications, resolving issues in real time, and coordinating adjustments from the Transport Operations Center. The role is accountable for maintaining service reliability, managing escalations, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.

In addition to the above, the role will provide support for the following Event Transport sub‑projects planning and implementation:

  • Developing Transport policies, procedures, Operational Plan and reports.
  • To build, train and motivate the Client Services team of paid staff and volunteers for the duration of the FWWC2027 Tournament.

The successful candidate is expected to be a self‑starter and multitasker who works well under pressure, can lead and manage a team and delivers to strict timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, manage and lead a team of Client Service.
  • Coordinate the transport and arrivals and departures service planning for each client group as named above to ensure the correct services, in accordance with FIFA service levels are planned for each client group to ensure the overall success of the tournament.
  • Liaison, in coordination with other transport stakeholders, with all transport mode suppliers including bus, fleet and public transport and other key functional areas to develop the services.
  • Direct the delivery of the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs), per client group. Ensure all agreements and necessary approvals are gained with client owners, transport service delivery functions both internal to FWWC2027 and external partners / suppliers and FIFA.
  • Lead the client services team to ensure all client service level planning is integrated with other key FWWC2027 functional areas at site and venue level including all stadiums and non‑competition sites.
  • Lead on ensuring the DSLAs are fully integrated with all concerned stakeholders.
  • Work closely with other transport team members (Bus, Fleet and Venues) to ensure the most efficient services are planned and delivered for each client group in line with agreed budgets.
  • Always with the aim of delivering the best client experience and optimising efficiencies where possible.
  • Lead on the delivery of all clients related information, communications and presentations at key client meetings plus any client transport guides/information and other related documents, both electronic and published.
  • Lead on the planning, staffing and management of VIP and FIFA hotels operations including planning of all resources and the recruitment and training of transport desk staff.
  • Support delivery of Transport for all test events prior to the FWWC2027.
  • Work with Senior Transport Management team to prepare risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies for each client group.
  • Act as the primary transport liaison for assigned client groups, maintaining daily engagement and providing operational updates.
  • Monitor transport service performance (fleet allocation, on‑time performance, demand vs. capacity) and initiate real‑time adjustments as required.
  • Manage and resolve operational issues, delays, last‑minute schedule changes, and escalations affecting client transport services.
  • Oversee major peak movements, including arrivals, departures, and high‑profile competition or ceremony transport waves.
  • Provide daily reporting on service levels, incidents, and client feedback, ensuring transparency and continuous operational improvement.
  • Safeguard client satisfaction while ensuring services remain aligned with approved entitlements and operational constraints.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of event transport experience in international major events in at least two (2) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games/Expo. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.

Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of teams’ leadership, business process management.
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Knowledge of Event Transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Strong IT skills; familiarity and comfort with MS Office (especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Proven solution orientated decision‑making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immutable deadlines.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands‑on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly‑owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
  • Deliver on‑demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
  • Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
  • Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
  • Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.

Qualifications and Experience

  • You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands‑on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
  • You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
  • You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
  • You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
  • High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
  • You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
  • You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
  • You will also have strong problem‑solving and decision‑making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

What if your adversarial mindset and attack intuition could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about cybersecurity threats?   • Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, or STRIDE

  • Background in cloud security, network security, or application security
  • Prior exposure to AI security, adversarial ML, or security data labeling
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GPEN, or similar

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside world-leading research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you

  • Apply your offensive security expertise to a genuinely novel and high-impact domain

description:
Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions.

The Operations Intern role at Yinson presents an exciting opportunity for individuals keen to develop their skills within the dynamic offshore production industry. This position offers you a chance to gain invaluable experience as part of the Onshore Operations Support team, and allows you to dive into various operational processes crucial for supporting offshore activities.

Yinson is a leading global integrated offshore production company committed to fostering innovation and sustainability.

Core Responsibilities

  • Assist the Onshore Team in monitoring and controlling daily operations, ensuring compliance with company standards and contributing to overall operational efficiency.
  • Manage communication with subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring timely and quality delivery of services and materials to bolster operational success.
  • Collaborate with various departments to meet both vessel and global demands, aiding in the enhancement of interdepartmental synergy and response capabilities.
  • Participate in workshops focused on Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices, including Task Risk Analysis and Critical Analysis, to heighten safety awareness and operational readiness.
  • Engage in client meetings to understand contracts and operational responsibilities, enhancing your educational experience.
  • Support the operations interface, promoting seamless interactions across all onshore and offshore departments.

Duties

  • Assist the Onshore Team in maintaining the Operations Management System and the Computerized Maintenance Management System, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Review and update procedures, work instructions, and job descriptions, aligning them with best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft documentation for Purchasing Order/Contract issuance, including Scopes of Work and Technical Analyses.
  • Participate in audits and inspections to assess the compliance and effectiveness of operational processes.
  • Monitor and document the status of material embarkation and disembarkation as well as third-party mobilisations and payments, relaying essential updates to the team.
  • All internship activities will be conducted onshore; please note the intern will not embark offshore.
  • Engage in quarterly feedback sessions with your supervisor to discuss performance, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • By the end of the internship, you will be well-versed in articulating the fundamentals of oil, gas, and water topsides, as well as marine processes related to cargo storage, handling, and offloading.

Health, Safety, And Environment (HSE) Responsibilities

  • Maintain a keen awareness of health and safety practices, proactively observing and reporting any unsafe activities, conditions, or situations.
  • Utilise the 'Stop Work' policy whenever unsafe conditions are noted, prioritising safety in all operational undertakings.

Qualifications

  • Mandatory: Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in engineering, with a commitment to a two-year internship.
  • Desirable: Coursework in technical subjects related to operations or engineering.

Skills & Experiences

  • Mandatory: Basic understanding of English and proficiency in MS Office applications.
  • Desirable: Intermediate level of English to facilitate clear communication in a multinational team environment.

An internship with Yinson in this Operations capacity is a unique opportunity for professional development while contributing to efficient operations in the offshore production sector. We highly encourage all qualified individuals who have a passion for operations and a desire to engage in a collaborative environment to apply.

Yinson is committed to promoting a diverse workplace and proudly operates as an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, disability, or any other dimension of diversity. Let’s work together to build a sustainable future!

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

  • Apoiar e conduzir testes de hipóteses (MVPs, A/B tests, protótipos), com forte embasamento analítico.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre stakeholders, áreas internas e clientes.
  • Comunicar resultados e recomendações de forma clara, estruturada e orientada à tomada de decisão.

  • Conhecimento em Power BI;

Diferencial

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience. It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency. We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious. You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’ll Expected To

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

What are we looking for?

  • People with disabilities (PcD - pessoa com deficiencia);
  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Good english speaking skills to be a part of a global team;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank’s culture.

title: Coordenador de Operações Comerciais (Sales Operations)
description:
Overview

VEM SER GUARACAMP! Há mais de 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro e seguimos crescendo com consistência, proximidade com o cliente e excelência na execução.

Aqui, temos Sangue Verde : senso de dono, foco em resultado e inconformismo com o status quo. Para isso, buscamos alguém que vá além da operação — queremos um(a) líder de Sales Operations que construa inteligência comercial e seja motor de crescimento sustentável .

Missão do cargo

Transformar a operação comercial em uma máquina previsível, escalável e orientada à rentabilidade, garantindo crescimento com margem, disciplina de execução e base sólida para expansão geográfica.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir e desdobrar metas comerciais com foco não apenas em volume, mas em rentabilidade, mix de produtos e qualidade da receita;
  • Construir modelos de forecast que tragam previsibilidade e suportem decisões estratégicas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado (canais, regiões, perfis de cliente) com foco em expansão no RJ e novos estados;
  • Apoiar decisões sobre portfólio, pricing e canais com base em dados e análises;
  • Atuar como parceiro direto da liderança comercial na construção da estratégia de crescimento.

Gestão de Margem & Disciplina Comercial

  • Estruturar políticas comerciais, garantindo controle sobre descontos, prazos e condições;
  • Desenvolver modelos de remuneração variável alinhados a estratégia e com incentivos corretos que equilibrem rentabilidade e volume;
  • Monitorar e corrigir distorções de margem por canal, carteira ou vendedor;
  • Criar mecanismos de governança que evitem erosão de preço e garantam consistência comercial.

Processos, Funil & Eficiência

  • Estruturar e padronizar o funil de vendas por canal (campo, distribuidores, televendas);
  • Implementar metodologias de abordagem comercial replicáveis e escaláveis;
  • Reduzir o ciclo de vendas e aumentar conversão com otimização de processos;
  • Identificar gargalos operacionais e liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua;
  • Aumentar produtividade comercial sem aumento proporcional de estrutura.

Dados, CRM & Automação

  • Liderar a evolução do CRM como fonte única da verdade comercial;
  • Garantir qualidade, disciplina e governança de dados;
  • Automatizar rotinas e integrar ferramentas para ganho de escala;
  • Desenvolver dashboards que conectem operação, estratégia e resultado;
  • Transformar dados em insights acionáveis para o time comercial.

Capacitação & Execução Comercial

  • Estruturar treinamentos contínuos de processo, abordagem e uso de ferramentas;
  • Garantir padronização e excelência na execução comercial;
  • Atuar como suporte estratégico para lideranças e vendedores;
  • Elevar o nível de maturidade do time comercial com base em dados e boas práticas.

Expansão & Escalabilidade

  • Estruturar modelos comerciais replicáveis para expansão em novos estados;
  • Apoiar definição de territórios, canais e estratégias de entrada;
  • Garantir que crescimento aconteça com controle, eficiência e consistência de marca;
  • Construir base operacional para “esverdear o Brasil” com sustentabilidade.

Desafios da Posição

  • Acesso direto a Gerência e Diretoria;
  • Construir a área do zero e ajudar na expansão da Guaracamp;
  • Crescer mantendo (ou aumentando) margem em um mercado altamente competitivo;
  • Trazer disciplina e previsibilidade para uma operação em expansão;
  • Equilibrar crescimento acelerado com estrutura e controle;
  • Influenciar decisões estratégicas com base em dados;
  • Preparar a operação do RJ para ser modelo de escala.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em Sales Operations, Planejamento Comercial ou áreas estratégicas de vendas;
  • Forte experiência com definição de metas, KPIs e modelos de remuneração;
  • Vivência com gestão de margem, precificação ou gestão de receita será diferencial relevante;
  • Experiência com CRM e ferramentas de automação comercial;
  • Alta capacidade analítica (Excel/Sheets avançado);
  • Experiência com melhoria de processos e gestão de projetos;
  • Perfil estruturador, com visão de negócio e forte orientação a resultado;
  • Experiência em bens de consumo (FMCG) será um diferencial.

title: Logistics Procurement Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Logistics Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing, contracting, and managing a portfolio of logistics services across the region, including transportation, warehousing, and customs brokers . Reporting to the LATAM Head of Procurement , this role is critical to ensuring cost-effective, reliable, and resilient logistics operations aligned with Lubrizol’s strategic and operational goals. The position requires close collaboration with cross‑functional teams, strong engagement with logistics service providers, and delivery of value through strategic sourcing, contract negotiations, supplier performance management, and market intelligence. This is a hybrid role, open to candidates based in either the Rio de Janeiro (Centro) or São Paulo (Parque da Cidade) offices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for logistics categories, including freight (road, ocean, air), warehousing, and customs brokerage services.
  • Build and manage relationships with regional and global logistics service providers, acting as a representative of the Lubrizol brand.
  • Support cross-functional business needs through close collaboration with logistics, supply chain, operations, finance, and quality teams.
  • Analyze logistics market trends, cost drivers, and risk factors to support business continuity planning and category strategy development.
  • Lead negotiations, implement logistics contracts, and ensure compliance with company policies, service level agreements (SLAs), and regional regulations.
  • Identify and deliver cost optimization opportunities while maintaining required service levels, safety, and operational performance.
  • Track key performance indicators and contribute to procurement reporting, dashboards, and service provider performance reviews.

Desired Background And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field. MBA is a plus.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in procurement, with strong exposure to logistics sourcing or transportation and customs management, preferably in a manufacturing or chemical industry environment.
  • Solid understanding of logistics cost structures, service models, customs brokerage processes, and contract management.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, cross‑functional environment.
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership, integrity, and strong customer and service orientation.

About the Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 10

The Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion. You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.

The Team

CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprise some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.

Responsibilities and Impact

  • Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of Excel-based models, written reports and presentations. Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesqueléticas e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores:

1. Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

2. Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

3. Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

4. Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-las para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo!

Venha fazer história com a gente!

#SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Atividades

  • Conferir as guias
  • Gerar o Arquivo XML
  • Fazer envio Eletrônico no Site da Operadora e Gerar Protocolo de Envio
  • Conferir o Valor do Protocolo com o Valor da Fatura no sistema
  • Colocar o número do Protocolo gerado no sistema
  • Enviar a guia física para operadora assinada e carimbada

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Pacote office básico
  • Experiência em faturamento hospitalar/clínica

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com o sistema Tasy

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: Botafogo, RJ.

Carga horária: De segunda à quinta das 8h às 18h e sexta-feira das 8h às 17h.

Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico, Total Pass e Vale Transporte.

title: Dental Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Under general supervision, provides chair side assistant to a dentist in clinics with an emphasis on a dental specialty in a postgraduate program in the College of Dentistry.

Supervisory Responsibility

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the College of Dentistry. External contacts include visitors to the College of Dentistry.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepares and sets up for all clinical sessions according to policies and procedures. Provides assistance to students and faculty during clinical procedures.
  • Takes and develops intra and extra-oral radiographs.
  • Cleans and sterilizes instruments, materials, devices, and equipment. Adheres to all infection control policies and procedures.
  • Receives and schedules patients for treatment in the area of responsibility.
  • Obtains and records information related to the medical history of patient(s) and routes patients for treatment in the area of responsibility.
  • Prepares sterile trays for all surgical procedures and other procedures as needed. Dispenses instruments, materials, and supplies.
  • Maintains dental equipment in a clean and operable condition.
  • Maintains adequate levels of supplies and materials in the designated supply areas and working areas. Provides information and direction to patients.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Competence in dental assistant skills, techniques, and duties.
  • Ability to take and develop radiographs and be knowledgeable of dental anatomy and bony structure in the upper and lower jaw to take diagnostic dental radiographs.
  • Knowledge of sterilization and infection control techniques. Knowledge of dental equipment, instruments, materials, and supplies. Ability to use a personal computer.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and customers.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma or General Equivalency Diploma (G.E.D.)
  • Four years of responsible work experience as a Dental Assistant in a dental office, clinic, and/or hospital.
  • Formal post-secondary accredited dental assisting training, Certification from the Dental Assisting National Board (DANB).
  • Must possess a current Dental Assistant registration license issued by the District of Columbia Board of Dentistry. Certified Dental Assistant (CDA) specifically in the postgraduate discipline.
  • Must possess a valid CPR card at the time of appointment or must successfully pass a CPR course within 30 days of hire.
  • Must have a very good working knowledge of using dental software.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not to be construed as a contract for employment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $42,000-$47,000

title: Freelance Data Scraping Engineer (Python)
description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.

In this role, as an AI Pilot - that's how we refer to this role at Mindrift - you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results. This part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands‑on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end‑to‑end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript‑rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross‑source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $17 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies.
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML).
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets).
  • Hands‑on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem‑solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self‑directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • A link to GitHub is a plus.
  • English proficiency: Upper‑intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands‑on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly – a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance‑based bonus programs that reward high‑quality work and consistent delivery.

  • Monitorar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura de dados, garantir que os sistemas de dados estejam sempre disponíveis e funcionando corretamente. Manter e monitorar pipelines de dados para garantir sua confiabilidade. Identificar e corrigir falhas e gargalos nos sistemas de dados;
  • Proficiência em Python para scripts, ETL, integração de dados. SQL essencial para manipulação e consulta de dados;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de NiFi, Airflow, familiaridade com Data Lake;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados, saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos;

title: Data Product Manager – Vibra Energia – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Cargo: Data Product Manager Sênior

Descrição

A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio.

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas
  • Armazenamento e processamento em nuvem, com camadas de data lake/warehouse e serving analítico
  • Modelagem analítica e semântica, padronização de métricas e qualidade de dados
  • BI e analytics avançado, suportando decisões do operacional ao estratégico
  • Ciência de dados, machine learning e IA, do experimento à produção
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos de dados e produtos de IA incluindo automações inteligentes e agentes de IA

A plataforma prioriza Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e padrões cloud-native, com tecnologias como:

  • BigQuery (camada central analítica)
  • Cloud Storage (data lake)
  • Pipelines/orquestração: Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows
  • Transformação/modelagem: Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL
  • Governança/metadata: Dataplex, Data Catalog
  • BI/consumo: Tableau, Power BI ou Looker
  • IA/ML: Vertex AI (training, endpoints, pipelines), práticas de MLOps/monitoramento
  • Observabilidade e segurança: Cloud Logging/Monitoring, auditoria, LGPD e eficiência de custos (FinOps)

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar estrategicamente o portfólio de produtos de dados e IA da Vibra Energia, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e maximização de impacto.
  • Definir padrões de produto (governança, qualidade, adoção, métricas de valor) e impulsionar iniciativas de IA e agentes de IA como produtos escaláveis e seguros.
  • Definir estratégia e governança do portfólio de produtos de dados/IA (priorização, funding, dependências, capacitação).
  • Conduzir rituais com liderança executiva e áreas-chave para definição de objetivos e roadmap.
  • Implementar modelo de “data product lifecycle”: discovery, delivery, operação, evolução e descontinuação.
  • Estabelecer padrões corporativos: métricas oficiais, camada semântica, catálogo, SLAs, data contracts e políticas de acesso.
  • Mensurar valor: ROI, ganhos de eficiência, qualidade, redução de tempo de decisão, risco e compliance.
  • Liderar iniciativas de adoção: enablement, comunicação, governança do consumo (BI: Tableau/Power BI/Looker).
  • Coordenar produtos de IA/agentes: requisitos, segurança, monitoramento, feedback loop, avaliação de performance e mitigação de riscos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência robusta em gestão de produtos de dados/analytics/IA em contexto corporativo.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura e governança de dados em GCP (BigQuery, pipelines, IAM, catálogo).
  • Experiência com mensuração de valor e gestão de stakeholders executivos.
  • Capacidade de liderar times/squads transversalmente e influenciar prioridades.
  • Diferenciais: operating model de Data & AI, governança de IA (policy, risk), finanças/ROI, agentic systems (quando aplicável).
  • Estratégia de produto aplicada a dados e IA.
  • Governança e métricas corporativas (single source of truth).
  • Gestão de portfólio e mensuração de valor (ROI/impacto).
  • Capacidade de estruturar produtos de agentes de IA com segurança e monitoramento.
  • Liderança executiva e influência.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de tomar decisões com trade-offs.
  • Comunicação de alto nível e negociação.
  • Foco em impacto e excelência operacional.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes.
  • PAE – Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual.
  • Convênio Farmácia . Descontos de até 85%.
  • Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev – variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário.
  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação.
  • Extensão das Licenças – Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias).
  • Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios.
  • Auxílio-Educacional – Para dependentes até o ensino médio.
  • TotalPass.
  • Assinatura Solar – Possibilidade de obter desconto especial na conta de energia a partir da adesão a um plano de geração distribuída.
  • Clube Smiles Corporativo – Descontos de até 50% nos planos oferecidos para você planejar suas viagens. Disponível também para cônjuge e filhos 18+.
  • Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem: Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo.

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

Job Description

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide. As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development. You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design. Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To Succeed In This Role, You Typically Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom‑designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field—from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea. Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, You Will Find

  • A collaborative and international work environment.
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization.
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments.

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

Interested? If you are passionate about offshore engineering and eager to contribute to innovative subsea solutions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of a company dedicated to innovation, engineering excellence, and safety.

title: Red Carpet Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Red Carpet Coordinator is responsible for managing the operational workflow of the Red Carpet and Rapid ART processes to ensure newly diagnosed and re‑engaged patients are linked to HIV medical care within 72 hours. This role focuses on referral coordination, patient navigation, clinic flow support, and data tracking to promote same‑day access to antiretroviral therapy (ART), retention in care, and viral suppression outcomes. The position supports daily clinic readiness, patient outreach, and grant‑related administrative functions in alignment with quality management and funding requirements.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third‑party payers, medical organizations, patients, and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinate same‑day or expedited medical appointments, laboratory services, and provider consultations.
  • Facilitate timely initiation of ART in collaboration with providers, pharmacies, and laboratories.
  • Track linkage to care within 72 hours and document services in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Monitor retention and viral suppression indicators to support continuity of care.
  • Communicate with interdisciplinary team members to ensure seamless transitions into care.
  • Receive, process, and track internal and external referrals for HIV primary care and Rapid ART services.
  • Monitor referral outcomes and conduct follow‑up on incomplete, missed, or delayed appointments.
  • Conduct outreach calls to support re‑engagement efforts and reduce gaps in care.
  • Identify and elevate barriers to care (e.g., transportation, insurance status, medication access) to appropriate team members.
  • Coordinate warm handoffs to internal departments and community‑based support services.
  • Prepare clinic areas daily to ensure operational readiness, including exam room preparation and supply inventory monitoring.
  • Provide patient check‑in and check‑out support as needed; serve as backup to front desk staff.
  • Conduct appointment reminder calls, lab reminders, and follow‑up communications.
  • Support medication refill coordination by processing refill requests and communicating with providers and pharmacies.
  • Assist with patient flow and triage by identifying urgent concerns and notifying licensed clinical staff appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation of coordination activities in the EMR.
  • Support infection control practices and clinic safety procedures.
  • Track and report referral‑related performance measures, including linkage to care, retention in care, and viral suppression.
  • Maintain tracking logs and data systems related to Rapid ART and Red Carpet initiatives.
  • Support quality management initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Assist with grant administrative tasks, documentation, and reporting requirements to ensure compliance with funding benchmarks.
  • Generate reports and maintain supporting documentation for audits and program monitoring.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of HIV treatment models, Rapid ART workflows, and linkage‑to‑care best practices preferred.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality regulations.
  • Ability to manage time‑sensitive workflows and prioritize urgent linkage activities.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills to monitor performance measures.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with patients from diverse backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated cultural competence and commitment to health equity.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in healthcare, public health, case coordination, or clinic operations preferred.
  • Experience in HIV care or infectious disease settings strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical record (EMR) systems required.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification preferred or obtained within organizational timeframe (if required by organization).

Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000–$45,000

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be best employer, and be safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the Amazon Workplace Health & Safety Brazil (BR WHS) is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as Program Manager for BR WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world‑class safety culture in the midst of Amazon's growth. In this role, responsibilities include diving deep into Operations processes; identifying risks through data and first‑hand experience; building and executing programs, and improving processes to eliminate risks; and influencing Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge the individual to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data‑driven decisions. In this role, cross‑functional work with members from various teams will be required, including Operations; Learning, ACEs, WHS, and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast‑paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have excellent judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

  • Development, review, approval, coordination, and leadership of large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs).

  • Experience managing medium to large‑scale projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering or Business Administration or a related field.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide counseling and psychological services to students; provide training and supervision to trainees; and to provide technical support to the department.

Supervisory Accountability

Intermediate

Nature And Scope

Interacts with deans, directors, faculty, administration, and students along with parents of students.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide counseling and diagnostic services to clients in emotional distress, and those with adjustment, career choice and other developmental concerns
  • Familiarity and experience with telehealth platforms
  • Activities are a hybrid of online and in-person services
  • This position requires 40 hours per week with the possibility of some evening hours
  • Ability to and experience in providing predominantly short-term therapy services
  • Provides crisis intervention to clients who may be in crisis such as being suicidal or danger to self or others
  • Determines when psychiatric referrals should be made
  • Responsible for screening and interviewing of intake and “same-day” clients and presenting a concise description of the presenting problems to staff for disposition
  • Performs outreach services involving workshops, presentations and psychoeducational information
  • Competence providing services with cultural humility and sensitivity and demonstrated ability and commitment to the mission of social justice
  • Organizes and prepares detailed psychological reports, case histories and treatment plans
  • Teaches in-service course(s) for trainees and staff
  • Provides training and supervision to trainees
  • Participates in in-service training programs, supervision, workshops, and case conferences

Core Competencies

  • Ability to work with college students with a range of presenting concerns including but not limited to cognitive, emotional, academic, and social distress, identity development, trauma, and behaviors of risk (e.g., suicidality)
  • Competence in both written and oral communication
  • Ability to promote, establish, and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with students, faculty, staff, university officials, parents of student and the general public
  • Ability to learn and operate current Electronic Health Record (EHR) system for documentation, supervision or other required data
  • Ability to work and carry out principal duties in-person and/or in a virtual environment
  • Familiarity and experience with telehealth platforms

Minimum Requirements

Doctoral Degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in clinical or counseling psychology

Minimum of two (2) years clinical experience, licensed or license eligible. If not yet licensed, then licensure must be within 2 years of the start date.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $79,000

description:
Job Description

The Finance Manager is responsible for daily oversight and monitoring of the finance and accounting activities assigned to themselves and/or their team. Additionally, the Finance Manager provides guidance, training, and consultation to employees and finance team members regarding their specific financial services and recruitment of staff as needed. Managers may also be responsible for the maintenance and administration of financial accounting systems supporting their assigned function and maintenance of processes and internal controls within their assigned area.

What You Will Do

  • Preparation of periodic budgets and forecasts for the Region(s).
  • Guides in the preparation of statutory accounts and tax returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies.
  • Guide in the preparation of returns relating to personal property, license, annual reports and other miscellaneous returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies.
  • Coordination and administration of external audits.
  • Provide in-depth analysis and reporting of financial information to senior management for purposes of making informed decisions and evaluating performance.
  • Maintain relationships with important vendors, service providers and business partners.
  • Participate in cross functional and/or multi-jurisdictional teams and projects across the ABS organization as needed.
  • Train, supervise, provide guidance, and coordinate the work of the financial staff while assuming accountability for service delivery.
  • Collaborate within the ABS organization to identify and resolve business issues.
  • Drive value and efficiency in assigned processes while minimizing risk and cost.
  • Maintain an effective internal controls environment by ensuring that FSG Policy and Procedural Statements are adhered to in assigned area. Drive the FSG strategy by identifying and implementing innovative solutions and services to improve and simplify processes.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent in accounting or finance.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years' previous accounting and tax experience in an international service or manufacturing company environment, with some experience in a financial management position.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Disciplined in relevant accounting or financial concepts and principles.
  • Technically proficient with financial and accounting systems / software.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report financial data.
  • Good interpersonal skills for dealing with internal and external clients.
  • Good managerial skills in the areas of team leadership, development, organization, planning and implementation.
  • Knowledge of computerized accounting systems, preferably Oracle.
  • A thorough knowledge of ABS and its businesses and processes is also beneficial to providing maximum effectiveness in this position.
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports directly to the Director of Finance. May have individual contributors report to them.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Descrição da vaga. Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento. Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado. Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade. O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também. Porque na Norsul, pertencer é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no planejamento tributário das operações existentes e de novos negócios, avaliando impactos fiscais e riscos envolvidos;
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos e consultivos, apoiando a estruturação tributária de novos modelos operacionais, contratos e operações;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar a legislação tributária (federal, estadual e municipal), avaliando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar oportunidades de eficiência fiscal, melhorias de processos e fortalecimento dos controles internos;
  • Atuar na preparação de respostas às fiscalizações e no acompanhamento de processos administrativos tributários, fornecendo subsídios técnicos e documentação de suporte;
  • Apoiar o gerenciamento de riscos fiscais e compliance tributário, incluindo acompanhamento de fiscalizações, auditorias e processos administrativos e judiciais;
  • Realizar interface com as áreas contábil, financeira, controladoria, jurídica e de negócios, garantindo alinhamento técnico;
  • Acompanhar auditorias externas, fornecendo subsídios técnicos e documentação de suporte;
  • Apoiar nas conciliações tributárias e controle de créditos;
  • Elaborar e revisar memorandos técnicos, pareceres e apresentações executivas sobre temas tributários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Contabilidade, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento tributário, área fiscal consultiva ou projetos tributários;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em tributação direta e indireta (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS);
  • Boa compreensão de contabilidade societária e impactos tributários nas demonstrações financeiras;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em projetos;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para interação com áreas multidisciplinares.

Informações adicionais

  • Benefícios que oferecemos
  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
  • Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
  • Nutricionista
  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer. Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias. Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria. A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório. Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua. Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto. Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor. Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega. Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

title: Brazil OR Colombia - Hybrid: Senior Software Developer - Platform & Complex Systems
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems

Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior‑level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Full stack or backend development
  • Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems
  • Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency
  • Cost‑aware architectural decisions
  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software.

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios
  • Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software, systems, engineering disciplines, data science, mathematics, physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features
  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • This posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams
  • Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs)
  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment
  • Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

Reminder: Applicants must select their technical track as part of the application process so they can be considered for the appropriate role covered by this posting.

title: Especialista em Cibersegurança – MODEC – Flamengo
description:
Especialista em Cibersegurança – MODEC – Flamengo

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal de contato técnico para cibersegurança de OT em todas as operações FPSO, garantindo a conformidade com a governança da empresa, as políticas da MODEC e as normas (IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISO 27019, IEC 61511).
  • Manter e atualizar o inventário de ativos OT (controladores, HMIs, servidores, sistemas de segurança, dispositivos de rede) e suas respectivas configurações; controlar e documentar todas as alterações de configuração e software.
  • Gerir os processos de controle de alterações dos equipamentos de OT (MOC), garantindo que os impactos na cibersegurança e segurança sejam avaliados, validados e autorizados antes da implementação.
  • Administrar e manter redes OT e infraestrutura de segurança, incluindo firewalls, IDS/IPS, zonas/conduítes e gateways para garantir segmentação, desempenho e conformidade.
  • Supervisionar a gestão do controle de acesso para usuários, serviços e dispositivos; aplicar o princípio do privilégio mínimo, auditar registos de acesso e controlar o acesso remoto de fornecedores e o uso de dispositivos móveis como pen drives, HDs, SSD, etc.
  • Realizar monitoramento contínuo de eventos e alertas de cibersegurança; coordenar detecção, resposta e restauração de incidentes alinhados com cibersegurança global de IT e OT Global, SOC e procedimentos offshore dos Técnicos de Sistemas.
  • Realizar avaliações de vulnerabilidade e gerir atividades de aplicação de patches, equilibrando a continuidade operacional, a segurança do sistema e os riscos de cibersegurança.
  • Implementar e monitorar controles de criptografia, gestão de chaves e backup/recuperação; validar a continuidade dos negócios e a prontidão para recuperação de desastres por meio de testes regulares.
  • Apoiar investigações de incidentes e análises de causa raiz (RCA) para eventos relacionados com OT ou cibersegurança, garantindo que ações corretivas e preventivas sejam implementadas.
  • Executar atividades de conformidade, garantia e auditoria, mantendo evidências para certificação IEC 62443, governança corporativa e inspeções regulatórias.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de desempenho de cibersegurança (KPIs, incidentes, status de conformidade) aos proprietários de ativos, OIM e cibersegurança OT corporativa.
  • Coordenar com operações, manutenção, TI, fornecedores e segurança corporativa para garantir a integração segura de OT-IT e intervenções de fornecedores em conformidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de digitalização e Indústria 4.0, garantindo que os controles de cibersegurança estejam incorporados em plataformas de computação de ponta, IoT e análise de dados.
  • Monitorar ameaças emergentes, segurança Zero-Trust e padrões em evolução para melhorar continuamente a resiliência da cibersegurança do FPSO.
  • Impulsionar a melhoria contínua dos procedimentos de cibersegurança OT, capacidades de deteção e documentação de governança.
  • Participar em revisões de arquitetura, design de controle e avaliações de segurança para implementações da Indústria 4.0.
  • Garantir que os controles de cibersegurança sejam incorporados por design em todas as novas tecnologias digitais implementadas em ambientes OT.
  • Garantir que as operações ROC e os projetos de digitalização estejam em conformidade com os padrões da indústria (por exemplo, IEC 62443, NIST CSF) e as políticas corporativas de cibersegurança.
  • Manter a supervisão do monitoramento remoto, alertas e resposta a incidentes para garantir operações seguras e confiáveis.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de segurança funcional e responsáveis pelo SIS para alinhar os riscos de cibersegurança, de modo que não comprometam os níveis de integridade de segurança (SIL).
  • Promover a consciencialização cibernética entre o pessoal de operações e manutenção, enfatizando práticas seguras para manutenção, desvio e gestão de substituição do SIS.
